items.statement: An independent investigation should conclude, when its validated model comparison supports the source trend, that Fe2NiSe4 has the lower Li2S decomposition barrier than Fe3Se4, while separating that result from model-dependent surface/path uncertainty.
items.expected: Complete results support Fe2NiSe4 below Fe3Se4 by approximately 0.47 eV and state coverage and model limitations; bounded failure states what cannot be concluded.
